headline: The desert remembers the pack
lede: Comet Drift HD's sand is no longer porcelain: every kart that leaves the asphalt stamps a soft rut that sinks the gutter, darkens the dune and fades over half a minute — and the dusk shadows finally fall away from the sun, not the kart's nose.

notes.text: #997 shipped: sand.js wear field (px ruts, ~35 s decay, base-captured sink/darken) + sun-fixed stretched shadows in Comet Drift HD.
Idle-pick honesty: HD honest-gap #1 (autopilot drift tiers) was fixed by apex grace #471 + bend charge #478 long ago — the stage closed it with numbers and pivoted to the sand.
